set.body: The dry run is the only warning before a sync rewrites fields on a ticket somebody else filed, and it prints those warnings only for items it would update. An item it would close returns early, so its overwrites are never shown. This is the exact case that recently rewrote another reporter's issue title, and had that item been closing rather than updating the dry run would have stayed silent.
set.title: Sync's dry run does not report the field overwrites a close would make

set.body: The Codex packaging change edited the work log and the roadmap without rebuilding the generated index, so the committed inventory and publish manifest no longer describe the log. Both continuous integration jobs fail on it: one reports a stale inventory, the other finds the manifest naming an older commit than the newest event.
set.title: Codex PR: regenerate the index so CI goes green

set.body: The Codex package currently carries skills and no lifecycle hooks, on the stated grounds that the two hosts use incompatible hook schemas and that Codex lacks a plan-approval event. Codex in fact supports the prompt-submit, stop, session-start, session-end and post-tool events, and reads the same output shape the existing hooks already emit. Until they ship, a Codex user gets written policy where a Claude user gets enforcement.
set.title: Ship the worklog hooks to Codex, not just the skills

set.body: The first feature of a new release wave is supposed to open that release's unreleased changelog section and raise the version everywhere it is recorded, in the same commit. The Codex work is that first feature and did neither, so the tree still reports the last released version while carrying unreleased work.
set.title: Open the 0.22.0 changelog section and bump the version lockstep

set.body: The plan-capture and status-report descriptions lost the concrete filename patterns they used to spell out. A description is the only text a host reads when deciding whether to invoke a skill, so a vaguer one is a weaker trigger. The rewording was undisclosed and no length limit required it: both replacements are longer than what they replaced.
set.title: Restore the file patterns in two skill descriptions
